info.description: Returns the permissions that a caller has on the specified taxonomy or policy tag.
info.title: Google Cloud Data Catalog API

requests.description: Searches Data Catalog for multiple resources like entries, tags that match a query. This is a custom method (https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/custom_methods) and does not return the complete resource, only the resource identifier and high level fields. Clients can subsequently call `Get` methods. Note that Data Catalog search queries do not guarantee full recall. Query results that match your query may not be returned, even in subsequent result pages. Also note that results returned (and not returned) can vary across repeated search queries. See [Data Catalog Search Syntax](https://cloud.google.com/data-catalog/docs/how-to/search-reference) for more information.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/catalog:search
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_DATA_CATALOG_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Get an entry by target resource name. This method allows clients to use the resource name from the source Google Cloud Platform service to get the Data Catalog Entry.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/entries:lookup
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_DATA_CATALOG_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Deletes a policy tag. Also deletes all of its descendant policy tags.
requests.name: DELETE /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_DATA_CATALOG_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets a policy tag.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_DATA_CATALOG_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates a policy tag.
requests.name: PATCH /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_DATA_CATALOG_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Renames an enum value in a tag template. The enum values have to be unique within one enum field. Thus, an enum value cannot be renamed with a name used in any other enum value within the same enum field.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{name}:rename
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_DATA_CATALOG_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists entries.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/entries
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_DATA_CATALOG_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates an entry. Only entries of 'FILESET' type or user-specified type can be created. Users should enable the Data Catalog API in the project identified by the `parent` parameter (see [Data Catalog Resource Project] (https://cloud.google.com/data-catalog/docs/concepts/resource-project) for more information). A maximum of 100,000 entries may be created per entry group.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/entries
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_DATA_CATALOG_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists entry groups.

requests.description: A maximum of 10,000 entry groups may be created per organization across all locations. Users should enable the Data Catalog API in the project identified by the `parent` parameter (see [Data Catalog Resource Project] (https://cloud.google.com/data-catalog/docs/concepts/resource-project) for more information).
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/entryGroups

requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/fields

requests.description: Creates a tag on an Entry. Note: The project identified by the `parent` parameter for the [tag](https://cloud.google.com/data-catalog/docs/reference/rest/v1beta1/projects.locations.entryGroups.entries.tags/create#path-parameters) and the [tag template](https://cloud.google.com/data-catalog/docs/reference/rest/v1beta1/projects.locations.tagTemplates/create#path-parameters) used to create the tag must be from the same organization.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/tags
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_DATA_CATALOG_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Exports all taxonomies and their policy tags in a project. This method generates SerializedTaxonomy protos with nested policy tags that can be used as an input for future ImportTaxonomies calls.

requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_CLOUD_DATA_CATALOG_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Imports all taxonomies and their policy tags to a project as new taxonomies. This method provides a bulk taxonomy / policy tag creation using nested proto structure.
